method: Actual WAV/Float32 samples, source-role-separated hashes, pitch/frame/tail lifecycle, PCM16 safety/mono/edge probes, non-gain residual, deterministic fixtures and uncapped actual-file sums. checks.method: Windowed Goertzel scan on actual generated output; synthetic diagnostic only.

mix.purpose: Six machinegun cues at actual preview interval; observe true frame overlap of redesigned duration.

limits: Grand/rich/dramatic character requires listening; no signal statistic approves those qualities.
Frequency, RMS, first-difference, DC and sample-peak measurements are not LUFS, device true peak, timbre approval or headphone QA.
A zero sample seam and bounded 5 ms edge metrics do not certify a seamless perceived loop.
Raw mixtures use no voice cap and can exceed unity; separate fixed headroom results do not establish the actual runtime mix.
Processing originals are existing first-decode Float32 files. This QA performs no new native decode, browser run or provider call.
